name: e-std3x80-first-push2
description: Card E short-pulse standard train (3 x 80 us, gap 150, td -60, fast 1) as the FIRST shot of a fresh boot on push2 firmware (on-time release). Primary knob: VID code. Columns: restore voltage, width and timing around the base edge. push1 first shots (release +9/+10 us) are not pooled; they only seed the first probes of an empty column (prior_policy).
equivalence_note: Post-park shots (PARK_EACH=1) count as first shots: on card E, 350 mV pw 80 twice with a park between was under/under, and without the park the second shot lost the link. Remove 'post-park' from equivalent_states to turn this off.
